messages:
maya (growth): Quick pulse — dashboard shows +28% MQLs WoW but Salesforce new leads are flat. Anyone seeing routing/tagging weirdness? cc @sam @jules
leadflow-bot: :warning: Pipeline alert: event sample_rate changed from 1.0 -> 0.5 at 2026-03-20T09:14:22Z. Investigate impacts on aggregated counts.
sam (analytics): I see the mismatch. GA4 sessions/events spiking, internal event stream down ~10% post-sample-change. Could be double-counting in GA4 or a tagging redirect. Running a quick dedupe cohort join.
sam (analytics): SQL I'm running (quick):
```
SELECT campaign, count(distinct user_pseudo_id) AS users, count(event_id) AS events
FROM events_raw
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-13' AND '2026-03-19'
  AND campaign IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```
jules (demand-gen): We pushed launch-posts + webinar emails Tues night. UTMs were the same A/B, but HubSpot routing rules were edited last week — ops mentioned a redirect on /demo for the AB test. Could that strip utm params on landing?
ada (ops): Confirmed: we deployed a temporary tracking redirect for the demo modal test at 03/19 23:40 and planned to revert today. Filing ops ticket #4621 to rollback if it’s the cause.
sam (analytics): If the redirect strips utm_source/utm_campaign GA4 can still pick up campaign via referral or last_non_direct, which will shift attribution buckets. Also dashboards use 7-day last_click; GA4 UI default is 30-day — different windows will change counts materially.
jules (demand-gen): Webinar snapshot — our internal register list shows 38 registrants attributed to campaign_LaunchA, SFDC only has 9 new lead records tied to that campaign. Owner assignment rules might also remap during routing.
maya (growth): Action items: 1) @sam run deduped event -> SFDC join and post numbers here (counts + mismatch rows). 2) @ada keep #4621 high priority and update when redirect reverted. 3) @jules pull 7-day vs 30-day cohort for LaunchA webinar and share. Sync 2pm in the channel.
sam (analytics): On it. Quick run returned: native_event_users=1,120; sfdc_new_leads=312; direct-mismatch-rows=131 (~42%). Will push detailed CSV to the reports bucket in 10m.
leadflow-bot: :file_folder: weekly_kpis.csv uploaded to gs://redwood-marketing/reports/2026-03-20/weekly_kpis.csv
jules (demand-gen): :thumbsup: thanks. I'll reconcile lead owner mapping and check HubSpot ingest logs for stripped query params.
maya (growth): Perfect — if anything looks like attribution model vs ingestion bug, we'll pause any paid bursts until we confirm. See you at 2pm for the quick triage.
